messages:
kevin: Noticed a bump in fncall rejects for `invoice_tool` on the new routing policy. Looks like most are schema mismatches. anyone watching this?

anya: Which route? dev-canary or canary-global?

kevin: route=canary-eu, policy=soft-then-strict. rejects spiked ~30/min starting ~10m ago.

leila: grabbing one payload from logs. raw model output we tried to parse: 
```
{"tool": "invoice_tool", "response": "{\"status\":\"ok\",\"invoice\":{\"id\":9876,\"amount\":49.99}}"}
```
Validator expected invoice.id as string and invoice.amount as string with currency.

kevin: so nested JSON-as-string plus numeric types. we've seen models collapse types on small quantized variants.

anya: can we add a parsing step to detect JSON-in-string and reparse before validation? That would reduce false rejects quickly.

leila: we already do a small unescape for top-level strings, but not deep nested ones. easy patch: run json.loads on string fields up to depth 2 for fncalls. low-risk feature flag.

observability-bot: FYI: current validation_sample_rate=0.02 (2%). store backlog shows 0 examples for that route due to downstream truncation.

tom: two telemetry asks: 1) emit a metric for "fncall_parsed_from_string" when we reparsed nested strings, 2) emit "fncall_type_coercion" when we coerce numbers->strings. console needs both to separate real rejects vs recoverable fixes.

console-product: +1. Without that split, on-call sees a single reject graph and it's hard to know if we should rollback the model. stacked bars (rejects / parsed-fix / coerced-fix) would be ideal.

anya: for immediate mitigation I propose: a) enable nested-string reparsing in validator behind canary flag b) add shallow coercion for invoice.id and invoice.amount (number->string) in soft-validate mode c) bump sample rate to 10% for route=canary-eu so we capture enough examples for triage.

kevin: agree. can we also annotate the alert with model_variant and runtime flags so console shows them? current alert only lists route.

leila: will do nested-string reparsing PR now, feature-flagged. includes emitting metric: fncall_parsed_from_string with labels {route, model_variant}.

observability-bot: Created short-lived alert: `canary_eu_fncall_rejects_1747994321` triggers at >25/min. sample_rate adjusted to 10% for matching routes.

tom: I'll wire up fncall_type_coercion metric and tag it as a "coercion_event" in telemetry. Console team: can the dashboard show both metrics and allow toggling between stacked and split views?

console-product: yes, we can add that. will create ticket and add the model_variant and runtime_flag columns. we can ship a small iteration to show stacked bars in the next alpha.

kevin: owners: leila takes reparsing PR, tom takes coercion metric, observability ensures route->route_name mapping includes model_variant, console-product handles dashboard. aim to have mitigations live in 90 minutes.

anya: one more: let's make sure coerced passes still log the original raw payload to the sample store (redact secrets) so we can do root cause if coercion hides a real bug.

leila: good call. PR will include raw_sample emission when reparsing/coercion occurs.

kevin: thanks all. we'll monitor the alert; if rejects remain high after these mitigations we escalate to rollback. :thumbsup:
